en.title: Number of Substrings with Two Equal Blocks of Zeros and Ones
en.description:
Count the substrings that have the same number of 0s and 1s, with all 0s contiguous and all 1s contiguous; identical text at different positions is counted separately. 0110 has equal counts but does not qualify.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: The first line contains the length n, and the second line contains the binary string; the original gives no length bound, so this site uses 0≤n≤200000, and an empty string is an empty line.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4; 0; 2. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Track the lengths of adjacent runs; each run boundary contributes the smaller of the lengths on its two sides.
